r0.why: Names, Trewartha 1966 American geographer, modified Köppen-Geiger to fix deficiencies, mid-latitudes closer to vegetation and genetic systems in [1]-[3].

r1.why: Tropical/polar unchanged, all 12 months 18 C, winterless frost-free, dry month under 60 mm, Ar/Aw/As rules in [4]-[8].

r2.why: BW/BS same meaning, aridity formula with T and P defined, desert/steppe/not-B cutoffs in [10]-[14].

r3.why: Dc coldest month below 0 C in interior North America/Asia, optional a/b third letter, 22.2 C split, Europe north of 44th parallel in [17]-[20].

r4.why: Eo above -10 C, Ec a month at or below -10 C, Ft 0-10 C allowing snow-free scrub/tundra, Fi all months below 0 C at North Pole ocean and Antarctic/Greenland plateaus in [21],[22],[25]-[27].
